title: One intake router: every Analyze drop resolves by zone id, not by DOM position
deviations_from_card: (1) Tests and code landed in ONE feat commit (20f17ee3e), not test-then-feat: the router retires ownedDropZoneProps/resolveWindowDropTarget, so a router-only commit would break the components' build. The catalog keys (162ef0b5e), the perf-budget raise (37488fb26) and the doc (0df78232b) are separate lock-held commits. (2) useAnalyzeFileAccept.ts is repurposed rather than deleted (card allowed no new files): it now holds useAnalyzeIntake (the plan applier + refusal list) and useRefusalText. (3) AnalyzeFileDropZone keeps a standalone mode (onFileChange, planned by planSingleSlot, inline refusal) because app/features/jobseeker/ProfileImport.tsx (outside the write set) uses it where no router listens; in the Analyze form it takes zone + onIntake and commits nothing on drop. (4) analyzeDragCounter.test.ts (same dir, outside the write set) was updated: it pinned the live region in AnalyzeProfileInput; it now pins it in AnalyzeForm and forbids it in the CV column. (5) perf-budget.json app/page.tsx 8664 -> 8669 KB (this card's +4151 bytes, no new module).
notes: Refusal keys: analyze.dropRefused ('{name} was not added. {reason}') + analyze.dropSingleSlot, real cs/de/fr. Refusals render once in AnalyzeForm below the columns (ul role=alert); the sample-CV fetch failure also reports there. Dropped files flow through the form setters (addCvFile / setJobDescriptionFile+setSelectedJdSlug(null) / setCompanyFile) and so into analyzeAttachmentStore via useAnalyzeForm's existing write-through effect; useAnalyzeCvFiles.ts / useAnalyzeForm.ts / AnalyzeTab.tsx untouched. tsc: 0 errors under app/ - the only tsc output is the untracked kpi-sim/ tree (foreign, pre-existing), so the raw exit is 1. Full test:unit: 1 BROKEN, app/_lib/python-runner-concurrency.test.ts 'aborted spawn kills the whole process tree' (process-tree timing under 5 concurrent builders; unrelated, reproduces alone). test:perf still red after my raise: app/page.tsx 8677 vs 8669 (remaining ~8 KB from siblings' UNCOMMITTED profile/devcases work), job-ingest.ts 402/400 (known), app/api/jds/generate/route.ts 3024/3023 (not in this card's graph). No browser DnD verification was possible (no dev server per the brief); the event wiring is covered only by source guards.
coordinator_notes: Integration: the drop overlay and its live region moved from AnalyzeProfileInput into AnalyzeForm; any later card touching the Analyze CV column should route files through the onIntake prop, never addCvFile directly (analyzeFileIntakeGate.test.ts guards it).
